name: quantconnect-mcp
description: QuantConnect cloud platform tools for AI assistants: projects, backtests, optimizations, live trading, Object Store, and LEAN coding help
long_description: An MCP server for QuantConnect's algorithmic trading platform. Write and compile LEAN algorithms, run backtests and parameter optimizations, inspect results, manage live deployments, use the Object Store, and get help from QuantConnect's AI coding tools.

tools.name: validate_quantconnect_auth
tools.description: Check that the configured QuantConnect credentials are accepted by the API.

tools.name: get_auth_status
tools.description: Show which QuantConnect account the server is configured for, without calling the API.

tools.name: read_account
tools.description: Read the organization account: organization ID, credit balance, and card on file.

tools.name: read_lean_versions
tools.description: List the LEAN engine versions available for backtests and live deployments.

tools.name: authorize_connection
tools.description: Start the OAuth flow that links an OAuth-based brokerage to QuantConnect.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project.

tools.name: read_project
tools.description: Read one project, or list every project when no ID is given.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Rename a project or change its description.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project, including its files and backtests.

tools.name: create_project_collaborator
tools.description: Add a collaborator to a project.

tools.name: read_project_collaborators
tools.description: List a project's collaborators and their permissions.

tools.name: update_project_collaborator
tools.description: Change a collaborator's permissions.

tools.name: delete_project_collaborator
tools.description: Remove a collaborator from a project.

tools.name: read_project_nodes
tools.description: List the backtest, research, and live nodes available to a project.

tools.name: update_project_nodes
tools.description: Choose which nodes a project may use.

tools.name: create_file
tools.description: Add a file to a project.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read one file from a project, or every file when no name is given.

tools.name: update_file_content
tools.description: Replace the full contents of a project file.

tools.name: update_file_name
tools.description: Rename a project file.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from a project.

tools.name: compile_project
tools.description: Compile a project. A successful compile ID is required to backtest, optimize, or deploy.

tools.name: read_compilation_result
tools.description: Read the state and build logs of a compile job.

tools.name: create_backtest
tools.description: Start a backtest from a successful compile.

tools.name: read_backtest
tools.description: Read a backtest's progress, statistics, and runtime results.

tools.name: list_backtests
tools.description: List a project's backtests.

tools.name: read_backtest_chart
tools.description: Read one chart from a backtest, sampled to a number of points.

tools.name: read_backtest_orders
tools.description: Read a page of a backtest's orders, at most 100 per call.

tools.name: read_backtest_insights
tools.description: Read a page of the alpha insights a backtest emitted, at most 100 per call.

tools.name: read_backtest_report
tools.description: Read the full HTML performance report for a completed backtest.

tools.name: update_backtest
tools.description: Rename a backtest or attach a note to it.

tools.name: delete_backtest
tools.description: Permanently delete a backtest.

tools.name: estimate_optimization_time
tools.description: Estimate how long a grid-search optimization would run, and show the QCC balance.

tools.name: create_optimization
tools.description: Launch a grid-search optimization. This spends QuantConnect Credit (QCC).

tools.name: read_optimization
tools.description: Read an optimization's status, settings, and backtest results.

tools.name: list_optimizations
tools.description: List a project's optimizations.

tools.name: update_optimization
tools.description: Rename an optimization.

tools.name: abort_optimization
tools.description: Abort a running optimization. Completed backtests are kept.

tools.name: delete_optimization
tools.description: Permanently delete an optimization and its results.

tools.name: create_live_algorithm
tools.description: Deploy a compiled project to live trading. This can place real orders.

tools.name: read_live_algorithm
tools.description: Read the status, runtime statistics, and charts of a project's live algorithm.

tools.name: list_live_algorithms
tools.description: List live algorithms, optionally filtered.

tools.name: read_live_logs
tools.description: Read a page of a live algorithm's logs, at most 250 lines per call.

tools.name: read_live_chart
tools.description: Read one chart from a live algorithm, sampled to a number of points.

tools.name: read_live_portfolio
tools.description: Read the current holdings and cash of a live algorithm.

tools.name: read_live_orders
tools.description: Read a page of a live algorithm's orders, at most 100 per call.

tools.name: read_live_insights
tools.description: Read a page of the alpha insights a live algorithm emitted, at most 100 per call.

tools.name: liquidate_live_algorithm
tools.description: Close every position of a live algorithm at market and stop it.

tools.name: stop_live_algorithm
tools.description: Stop a live algorithm, leaving its positions open.

tools.name: create_live_command
tools.description: Send a command to a running live algorithm.

tools.name: broadcast_live_command
tools.description: Send a command to every live algorithm in the organization.

tools.name: list_object_store
tools.description: List Object Store keys, optionally under a path.

tools.name: read_object_store_properties
tools.description: Read an Object Store entry's metadata: size, modified time, and a content preview.

tools.name: get_object_store_download
tools.description: Prepare a download of Object Store entries, in two steps.

tools.name: upload_object_store_object
tools.description: Write a text value to the Object Store, replacing any existing value at the key.

tools.name: delete_object_store_object
tools.description: Delete an Object Store entry.

tools.name: check_syntax
tools.description: Check algorithm code for syntax and API errors without compiling a project.

tools.name: initialize_backtest
tools.description: Run an algorithm for a few seconds to surface initialization errors.

tools.name: enhance_error
tools.description: Explain a LEAN compile or runtime error and suggest fixes.

tools.name: search_quantconnect
tools.description: Search QuantConnect documentation, examples, API stubs, and forum posts.

tools.name: complete_code
tools.description: Suggest LEAN API completions for a partial expression, for example "self.add_eq".

tools.name: convert_to_pep8
tools.description: Rewrite Python algorithm code from the legacy PascalCase API to PEP 8 snake_case.

QUANTCONNECT_USER_ID.title: QuantConnect User ID
QUANTCONNECT_USER_ID.description: Your QuantConnect account user ID (numeric identifier)

QUANTCONNECT_API_TOKEN.title: QuantConnect API Token
QUANTCONNECT_API_TOKEN.description: Your QuantConnect API token for authentication

QUANTCONNECT_ORGANIZATION_ID.title: QuantConnect Organization ID
QUANTCONNECT_ORGANIZATION_ID.description: Organization for new projects and the Object Store. Leave blank to use your preferred organization.
